title: xwf-world-heavyweight
label: C.R.

won.source: Nothing held records when or how he won it; he is billed the champion in the act of defending it.

how: Held it through a no-disqualification defence against Limp Bizkit on Primetime Central's own New Era supercard, 20 April 2003, and was still champion at the last word the record has (/promotions/ptc/archive/new-era-2003-results.html).
note: No event is linked: the only held night of this reign is a DEFENCE on another promotion's card, not the night it was won, and the event field records where a reign began.
